purpose: Independent real-repository coding productivity pilot; experimental, not release evidence alone
grader_instructions: Private frozen acceptance script in ignored, inaccessible-to-model benchmark storage. Score all 19 checks per issue; no retries or post-hoc edits to scoring rules.
technical_note: The CI and model probe do not demonstrate a coding productivity benefit. Windows workspace-write sandbox isolation and effective model identity are not independently attested. No paid API key, release, deploy or live service change.

tasks.description: Implement open issue #408 in this pinned real repository. Add opt-in `rss-compare --sort-url` CLI flag (off by default), and `compare_saved_rss_headlines(..., sort_url=False)` keyword. When true, sort rows within `newly_seen`, `still_seen`, `not_seen_in_newer` by exact string `url` independently for JSON, CSV and Markdown reports. Permuting input RSS rows must not change sorted reports; default behavior and JSON schema/CSV header/Markdown content must stay unchanged without flag. Keep membership/counts, retitle detection, first-seen deduplication, missing-metadata attention, formula/Markdown escaping, no-overwrite output, provenance/caveats, and offline operation. Add focused tests and run the existing offline RSS comparison tests.

Implement open issue #410 in this pinned real repository. Add opt-in `rss-compare --show-retitles` CLI flag (off by default), and `compare_saved_rss_headlines(..., show_retitles=False)` keyword. With flag, JSON adds `retitled_urls` array only for exact shared URLs whose first-seen deduplicated title differs, with keys `url`, `older_title`, `newer_title`; Markdown adds a clearly labeled, escaped older/newer title table. Default JSON/Markdown must not change; CSV output remains unchanged even with flag because it already has old/new fields. Preserve quality/attention, counts, provenance, no-overwrite, no network, and safe Markdown/CSV output. Add focused offline tests and run existing RSS comparison tests.
